concept.hr: Veća konstelacija prema šumu; nositelji koji se ne ometaju
concept.en: Constellation size against noise; subcarriers that do not interfere

summary.hr: Uz isti šum 64-QAM nosi 6 bitova, ali griješi u 5 % simbola; 5 dB više to vraća. OFDM: uskopojasna smetnja kvari samo jedan nositelj.
summary.en: At the same noise 64-QAM carries 6 bits but gets 5 % of symbols wrong; 5 dB more buys it back. OFDM: a narrow-band interferer spoils one carrier.

what.hr: Tekst odjeljaka o QAM-u, OFDM-u i PSK-u (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod) i model appleta applet_qpsk.html (mapiranje, Gaussov šum, odluka po najbližem simbolu)
what.en: The text of the QAM, OFDM and PSK sections (50ohm.de, Croatian translation) and the model of the applet applet_qpsk.html (mapping, Gaussian noise, nearest-symbol decision)

changes.hr: Odjeljci sažeti u objašnjenje i prevedeni na engleski; model QPSK-a proširen na kvadratni M-QAM, SNR u dB, brojanje pogrešaka uz teorijski SER i OFDM način; ništa nije preuzeto doslovno
changes.en: The sections summarised into the explanation and translated into English; the QPSK model extended to square M-QAM, SNR in dB, error counts against the theoretical SER and an OFDM mode; nothing is copied verbatim
